messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the most common long‑weekend holidays that Canadians usually take advantage of in 2023. (Note that some holidays vary by province, so the exact dates may differ slightly depending on where you live.)

| Holiday | Date(s) in 2023 | Typical long‑weekend span |
|---------|-----------------|---------------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Sunday, Jan 1 | Sat Dec 31 – Mon Jan 2 (includes the New Year’s Eve celebration) |
| **Family Day** *(Ontario, BC, AB, SK, MB)* | Monday, Feb 20 | Sat Feb 18 – Mon Feb 20 |
| **Good Friday** | Friday, Apr 7 | Fri Apr 7 – Sun Apr 9 |
| **Victoria Day** | Monday, May 22 | Sat May 20 – Mon May 22 |
| **Canada Day** | Saturday, Jul 1 | Sat Jul 1 – Mon Jul 3 |
| **Labour Day** | Monday, Sep 4 | Sat Sep 2 – Mon Sep 4 |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday, Oct 9 | Sat Oct 7 – Mon Oct 9 |
| **Christmas & Boxing Day** | Mon‑Tue, Dec 25‑26 | Sat Dec 23 – Tue Dec 26 |

These are the federal holidays that most people use to book a short break. Provincial holidays (e.g., Family Day in Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, etc.) follow the same pattern—if the holiday falls on a Monday, the preceding weekend becomes a long weekend; if it falls on a Friday, the following weekend does. Feel free to tweak the list based on your target audience’s province!
